name: facet-star
note: 11 Facet Star (references/packaging/11_facet_star_v003.png, sketch 2026-11-12): 100 x 100 mm footprint, 85 mm tall closed (the sketch is wider than tall). Thick-walled base whose four sides are split into a facet_grid of cells, each a shallow inverted pyramid (centre facet_depth in from the face, ridges on the cube plane). A gold four-point star sits on the centre crossing of the front. A thin lid, hinged at the back, opening 105 deg; the upper lid_trim of its edge is gold, the rest black. Under it a card with a thumb notch on the right and Perhaps set in gold serif (card_text). Black velvet lining; the compartment has a thick border (liner_border wide, liner_drop below the rim). Black version: fine black leather grain outside, black velvet lining, black card.

card_text.note: as the designer's lid detail (2026-11-12): Perhaps in a classic serif; the macOS Georgia outline is baked to a mesh at build time, the font file is not shipped

lid_text.note: designer request 2026-11-12: Perhaps on the lid top, same gold serif as the card

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB; renders swap in the library look via config/presets/box_facet_star_look.json.
